title: Product Owner Treasury Platform (f/m/d)
description:
Join the team building a treasury management platform used by corporates across Europe.

What you'll do
- Own the backlog and roadmap for payments and liquidity features
- Run refinement and acceptance with a team of eight

What you bring
- Several years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst working with development teams in an agile setting, including the preparation and prioritisation of backlogs, the writing of user stories and acceptance criteria, the coordination of stakeholders from finance, compliance and operations, the planning of releases with engineering leads, and the evaluation of product metrics together with data analysts, ideally for payment, treasury or banking software used by corporate customers
- Good English; German is a plus
